title: Micro-BIC 2026 at 80 000, under 83 600, LMNP ceiling warning
question: Meme immeuble meuble, 900 000 EUR, frais 60 000 EUR, 6 666,67 EUR de loyers par mois, charges 6 000 EUR, taxe fonciere 5 000 EUR, tranche 41 %, micro-BIC, mais revenus 2026. Et le statut LMNP tient-il ?
hand_computation: 80 000.04 under 83 600 (2026): micro-BIC open; taxable 40 000.02; tax 58.2 % = 23 280.01; receipts above 23 000 (R6): LMNP status depends on other income; net 69 000.04 / 960 000 = 7.1875 %; after tax 45 720.03 / 960 000 = 4.7625 %.
truth_source: Hand computation on 2026-10-11 from rules R1 to R9 of skills/rental-yield-france/references/regles-fiscales.md (service-public.fr F1991, F32744, F1419 checked 2026-04-15; CGI art. 31, 32, 39 C, 50-0, 155, 156; BOFiP BOI-BIC-CHAMP-40-20 and BOI-BIC-AMT-20-40-10-20).
